verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
You have my heart, and I am yours forever
You are my strength, God of grace and power

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
And everything, You hold in Your hands
Still You make time for me, I can't understand

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Praise you God of earth and sky
How beautiful is Your unfailing love
Unfailing love

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
And You never change, God You remain
The Holy one, my Unfailing Love
Unfailing love

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
You are my rock, the one I hold on to
You are my song, and I sing for You
